question: Of customers whose first non-cancelled order was in 2024, what share placed another non-cancelled order within 365 days after their first order? Use the orders table. Give a fraction.
reference_sql: WITH o AS (SELECT user_id, created_at FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders` WHERE status != 'Cancelled'), f AS (SELECT user_id, MIN(created_at) first_at FROM o GROUP BY 1) SELECT COUNTIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.user_id = f.user_id AND o.created_at > f.first_at AND o.created_at <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(f.first_at, INTERVAL 365 DAY))) / COUNT(*) AS answer FROM f WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_at) = 2024
agent_sql:
WITH valid AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, created_at
  FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.orders`
  WHERE status != 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP('2019-01-01')
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP('2026-10-01')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id, created_at,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at, order_id) AS rn
  FROM valid
),
first_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, order_id AS first_order_id, created_at AS first_at
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND created_at >= TIMESTAMP('2024-01-01')
    AND created_at < TIMESTAMP('2025-01-01')
),
flags AS (
  SELECT f.user_id,
         MAX(IF(v.order_id IS NOT NULL, 1, 0)) AS repeated
  FROM first_orders f
  LEFT JOIN valid v
    ON v.user_id = f.user_id
   AND v.order_id != f.first_order_id
   AND v.created_at >= f.first_at
   AND v.created_at <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(f.first_at, INTERVAL 365 DAY)
  GROUP BY f.user_id
)
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(repeated), COUNT(*)) AS answer
FROM flags

question: Which product category had the largest increase in item return rate from 2024 to 2025? Return rate = Returned items / (Complete + Returned items) by item order year. Only include categories with at least 500 Complete or Returned items in each year. Give the category name.
reference_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT p.category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) y, COUNTIF(i.status = 'Returned') ret, COUNTIF(i.status IN ('Complete', 'Returned')) base FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` i JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` p ON i.product_id = p.id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i.created_at) IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT a.category AS answer FROM r a JOIN r b ON a.category = b.category AND a.y = 2025 AND b.y = 2024 WHERE a.base >= 500 AND b.base >= 500 ORDER BY a.ret / a.base - b.ret / b.base DESC LIMIT 1
agent_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.category,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM oi.created_at) AS yr,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         COUNTIF(oi.status = 'Returned') AS returned
  FROM `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.order_items` oi
  JOIN `analyst-agent-512103.thelook_clean.products` p ON oi.product_id = p.id
  WHERE oi.status IN ('Complete','Returned')
    AND oi.created_at >= TIMESTAMP('2024-01-01')
    AND oi.created_at < TIMESTAMP('2026-01-01')
  GROUP BY p.category, yr
),
piv AS (
  SELECT category,
         SUM(IF(yr=2024, n, 0)) AS n24,
         SUM(IF(yr=2025, n, 0)) AS n25,
         SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(yr=2024, returned, 0)), SUM(IF(yr=2024, n, 0))) AS r24,
         SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(IF(yr=2025, returned, 0)), SUM(IF(yr=2025, n, 0))) AS r25
  FROM base
  GROUP BY category
)
SELECT category AS answer
FROM piv
WHERE n24 >= 500 AND n25 >= 500
ORDER BY r25 - r24 DESC
LIMIT 1
